facts.fact: 认识三个月，我已经 fall in love
facts.anchor: I only met her three months ago, and I’m already falling in love.

facts.fact: 保密协定：先不告诉 Bailey——「看看接下来几周」
facts.anchor: Can we see how the next weeks go before we tell anyone?

facts.fact: Thanksgiving 上 Bailey 咕哝过「你们在一起也行」——没来得及确认
facts.anchor: he mumbled something about being okay if we were together

facts.fact: 「You're mine」——centre ice 没法宣布，但我知道就够
facts.anchor: Even if I can’t declare it on the screen at centre ice

facts.fact: 她提议来同床被否——攒年假会累出偏头痛+内疚
facts.anchor: You’ll end up with migraines and then carry guilt

facts.fact: stimming 科普：内部为主（脑内重复/数数）；跑步会拍手扇指——所以避人
facts.anchor: I bash my hands together or flap my fingers.

facts.fact: Bailey 在场规则：不亲热不同床
facts.anchor: we don’t kiss or touch each other intimately, and we don’t share a bed if he’s here.

facts.fact: Rudders 盘问的官方回复：「帮她戴隐形眼镜」——可她不戴隐形
facts.anchor: I was helping her with her contact lens.
